guide.lead: From download to your first game on screen. Most of it happens once.
guide.s1.text: Download it for your computer or phone below. On a NAS or server, run the Docker image and open it in a browser instead.
guide.s1.title: Install the app
guide.s2.text: Start your PS5's payload loader as you usually do, then press Send helper on the Connection screen. The helper is how the app talks to the console.
guide.s2.title: Load the helper on the PS5
guide.s3.text: Type the console's address on the Connection screen, or let the app find it on your network. The status at the bottom turns green when it's there.
guide.s3.title: Connect
guide.s4.text: Open Play › Set up and follow the checklist. Each step ticks by itself when it's done; the one only the console can show (its rest-mode settings) you tick yourself.
guide.s4.title: Set up Play
guide.s5.text: Press Play on Home. To add a game, drop it on Upload & Install; it shows up in Games with Play ready when it's installed.
guide.s5.title: Play, and fill it up
guide.title: Get started in five steps
hero.lead: Play your PS5 from your computer, phone or browser, and manage everything on it from the same app: install games, move files, keep your saves and set it all up with a checklist that ticks itself.
hero.new_text122: Play together from anywhere, Tailscale built in, Share, and every PS5 on one page
hero.title: Your PS5, on every screen.
howto.away.friends2: Only want a friend far away to play along? Send them an internet invite from Play Together instead: they don't need a Tailscale account.
howto.away.title: Play away from home
howto.away.ts1: At home, open Connection, press Put this PS5 on Tailscale and sign in to your Tailscale account (a free one works).
howto.away.ts2: On the phone or laptop you'll take with you, open Settings › Tailscale and sign in to the same account. No Tailscale app needed.
howto.away.ts3: Away from home, connect and play as usual. The status bar shows via Tailscale, direct or relayed, with the delay.
howto.away.ts_note: Only Remote Play and PS5Upload can be reached through Tailscale. How smooth it is depends on your home connection's upload speed, and waking the PS5 from rest mode from far away may not work: leave it on. Never open the app's ports to the internet instead: it has no password. Headscale works too, under Advanced.
howto.docker.s1: Run the Docker image on your NAS or server (the command is below).
howto.docker.s2: Open port 19113 on that machine in a browser.
howto.docker.s3: The whole app is there. Play needs an https:// page, so to play from another computer or a phone, put the engine behind an https proxy or use the desktop or phone app.
howto.docker.title: Use it from a browser (Docker)
howto.help.note2: The in-app Help screen answers most questions. Its FAQ is in English, and it is also on this site, with a search.
howto.help.s1: Open Bug Report in the sidebar: it builds a report with the app's logs.
howto.help.s2: Attach it to an issue on GitHub, or ask on Discord.
howto.help.s3: Hard to catch? Turn on Detailed logs in the Logs tab, make it happen again, then build the report. It turns itself off after 24 hours.
howto.help.title: Something isn't working
howto.install.s1: Drop the package on Upload & Install, or pick it with Browse.
howto.install.s2: It joins the queue and installs; you can keep using the app.
howto.install.s3: For an update or add-on, open the game's page in Games and install it from there.
howto.install.title: Install a game or an update
howto.lag.note: The PS5's own part and your TV's delay aren't in these numbers; use the TV's game mode.
howto.lag.s1: Press Stats on the picture's bar (on a phone, in the ⋯ menu).
howto.lag.s2: The line net · queue · decode · screen shows each stage in ms: the network to this device, the wait for the decoder, decoding, and showing the picture.
howto.lag.s3: A big net: a cable for the PS5 and 5 GHz Wi-Fi help most. A big decode: try 720p. Low latency in Play's settings shortens the queue.
howto.lag.title: See where Play's delay comes from
howto.pad.note: In the PS5Upload app on a phone, Play shows the computer that's playing: tap Use this device as its controller.
howto.pad.s2: Press the phone button on the picture's bar.
howto.pad.s3: Scan the code with the phone's camera. The phone opens a controller; turn it sideways.
howto.pad.title: Play with a phone as the controller
howto.phone.note: Play in a browser needs an https:// page. Over a plain http:// address, play with the app.
howto.phone.s1: Install the app: the Android or iPhone download below. The iPhone app is sideloaded with AltStore or Sideloadly and an Apple ID; a free one works.
howto.phone.s2: Open Connection, enter the PS5's address and send the helper. The app talks to the PS5 directly, Play included.
howto.phone.s3: Rather use a browser? Open port 19113 of a computer at home that runs the Docker image, or port 9180 of the PS5 for its own page (first turn on Allow other devices on the network in that page's Settings).
howto.phone.title: Use it from a phone
howto.saves.note: While playing, the game panel takes a snapshot of the running game's save in one press.
howto.saves.s1: Open Save Data and choose a folder for backups.
howto.saves.s2: Back up one game, or turn on automatic backups.
howto.saves.s3: To go back, pick a backup and press Restore (close the game first).
howto.saves.title: Back up and restore saves
howto.sharp.note: It runs on your graphics card and turns itself off if the device can't keep up.
howto.sharp.s2: Turn on Upscale to the screen, and set Sharpen to taste.
howto.sharp.title: Make the picture sharper on a big screen
howto.title: How do I…
howto.together.note3: Friend somewhere else? Choose Internet before you start, or above the QR code, and send them that link. The FAQ has the details (in English).
howto.together.s1b: Open Play › Play Together and press Start and invite. Already playing? Press the people button on the picture's bar (on a phone, ⋯ › Play Together).
howto.together.s2: Send your friend the link, or let them scan the QR code. Press Allow when their name pops up.
howto.together.s3: On the TV, they press PS and pick Quick Play (or their own user), then play.
howto.together.title: Play together with a friend
howto.tv.s1: The TV turns on with the PS5 because of HDMI-CEC.
howto.tv.s2: On the PS5, turn off Settings › System › HDMI › Enable HDMI Device Link, or turn off CEC on the TV (Anynet+, SIMPLINK, BRAVIA Sync…).
howto.tv.s3: Wake and Play now leave the TV off. The controller won't turn the TV on any more either.
howto.tv.title: Wake the PS5 without the TV
howto.watch.s1: In the phone panel, choose To watch.
howto.watch.s2: Friends scan the code: the stream plays in their browser, with sound after a tap.
howto.watch.s3: Press Hand the controller next to someone to let them play.
howto.watch.title: Let friends watch

meta.description2: PS5Upload streams your PS5 to your computer, phone or browser, lets friends join your game from a link, and manages the console from there: play, install, move games and saves, all in one app. Free and open source for macOS, Windows, Linux, Android, iPhone and Docker.
meta.og2: Play and manage your PS5 from any screen, and play together with friends from a link. Free and open source for macOS, Windows, Linux, Android, iPhone and Docker.
meta.title: PS5Upload — play and manage your PS5 from any screen
nav.coffee_title: PS5Upload is free. A coffee for me, or tokens for the AI that writes the code, keeps it going.
news.title: News
play.home.t1b: Wakes the console and signs in for you, asking for your PS5 passcode if there is one
play.home.t2b: Keeps playing in a mini player while you use other screens, and over other apps on Android
play.home.t3: Fit, Fill or Stretch the picture; full screen and picture in picture
play.home.text: The Play card sits at the top of Home: press Play, or pick up your last game where you left it. Every game's page has Play too, which starts the game and streams it in one go.
play.home.title: One press from Home
play.kbm.t1: Controller: the keys and mouse act as a controller, as before
play.kbm.t2: Keyboard & mouse: the PS5 gets a real keyboard and mouse, for games and apps that support them, the PS5's browser and homebrew such as terminals
play.kbm.t3: Mixed: a real mouse, while the keys act as a controller and WASD moves
play.kbm.text: Play has three ways to use your keyboard and mouse, kept for each game. Switch with the button on the stream bar, or with ⌃ ⌥ M (Ctrl+Alt+M on Windows and Linux).
play.kbm.title: Your keyboard and mouse, as the PS5's own
play.lead: Your console's screen, streamed to the device in front of you. It wakes the PS5 from rest mode, signs your user in, and you play with a controller, the keyboard or touch.
play.phones.t4: Friends somewhere else? Play Together gives them their own player from a link
play.phones.title: Phones as controllers and screens
play.release.t1: A card shows the keys the first time, and again when you seem to be looking for the way out
play.release.t2: A faint "⌃ ⌥ to release" stays at the top while you play
play.release.t3: Both shortcuts can be changed in Play › Settings › Controls › Shortcuts
play.release.text: Click the picture and the PS5 has your keyboard and mouse. Press and let go of ⌃ ⌥ (Ctrl+Alt on Windows and Linux) to get them back.
play.release.title: Click to play, ⌃ ⌥ to get out
play.setup.s2: Sign in to a user and give it an account ID
play.setup.s5b: Pair this app with the console, or with the PIN the PS5 shows
play.setup.text: Play › Set up walks through everything a console needs, in order. It reads the console every few seconds and ticks each step as it's done; where the app can do the step, the button is right there.
play.setup.title: Set up once, with a checklist that ticks itself
play.title: Play is the heart of the app
play.together.t1: Phones as controllers, up to four
play.together.t2: Watch party with sound, up to four watchers
play.together.t3: Instant replay, screenshots and clips, saved to your phone's photos
play.together.text: Scan a code and a phone becomes a controller, or a screen for friends to watch from the couch. Hand a watcher the controller when it's their turn.
play.touchpad.pad: A phone used as a controller has a Touchpad & keyboard tab too.
play.touchpad.text: On a phone or tablet, switch the picture from Controller to Touchpad: drag to move the pointer, tap to click, tap with two fingers to right-click and drag with two to scroll. ⌨ opens your phone's keyboard and types on the PS5.
play.touchpad.title: A phone as the PS5's touchpad and keyboard
sh.allow.text2: Your friend opens the link, in their browser or in PS5Upload's Share screen, and picks what to take. Nothing moves until you press Allow, and then it goes straight between you, never through a server.
sh.allow.title: Your friend asks, you allow
sh.lead: Every game and Collection item has Share. Send a friend your saves, screenshots and clips, which cheats are on, your controls, a note, and homebrew apps.
sh.pick.t1: A save goes into your friend's own save of the game: trophies and your account stay yours
sh.pick.t2: Homebrew only: retail games, their updates and add-ons can't be shared, in any format
sh.pick.text: Choose the app, its save, your captures, cheats and controls, add a note, then press Share. You get a link and a QR code that work on your Wi-Fi and over the internet.
sh.pick.title: Pick what to send
sh.receive.text: Your friend sees who shared what, picks the items, and keeps the app in their Collection or installs it to their PS5.
sh.receive.title: Receive
sh.title: Share: your stuff, straight to a friend
thanks.anonymous: …and {n} more who chose to stay anonymous. Thank you too.
thanks.intro: PS5Upload is free, and it keeps getting better because of the people below. Every coffee pays for test hardware, late nights and the next release. Thank you, all of you.
thanks.kofi_body: The easiest way: a coffee, or whatever you like. Your name joins the wall with the next release (or stay anonymous).
thanks.kofi_sub: Card or PayPal, once or monthly
thanks.network_only: Send only {coin} on the {network} network. Anything else can't be recovered.
thanks.note: Names are shown as you gave them on Ko-fi, and the list grows with each release. Want yours changed or taken off? Just say so on Discord.
thanks.title: Thank you
thanks.xrp_no_tag: No destination tag needed: this is my own wallet, not an exchange.
together.app.text: A friend with PS5Upload is asked whether to open the invite in the app, the way Slack and Zoom links do, or join from Play › Join a friend with the link, the code, a QR scan or Playing nearby.
together.app.title: Links open in the app
together.lead2: Send a link and friends join the game you're playing as Player 2, 3 and 4, each with their own controller, from your Wi-Fi or from anywhere. They need no PS5 and no app: a browser on a phone, tablet or computer will do.
together.net.text2: The link works from anywhere, a phone on mobile data too, and the picture comes as a video stream that holds 60 fps when a few packets go missing. A small server only introduces you: picture, sound and controls go straight between you. On a network that blocks direct connections, Tailscale gets through.
together.net.title: Friends anywhere, no relay
together.phone.t1: The picture stays within about 150 ms of the console, with rumble on their controller
together.phone.t2: The game's sound, with a Mute button that's remembered
together.phone.t3: A Wi-Fi blip doesn't cost them their spot: they're back as the same player within a minute
together.phone.text: A friend on a phone plays full screen with on-screen controls, the buttons out of the way until they press and hold the picture. A controller over USB or Bluetooth works too, and so does the keyboard.
together.phone.title: On a phone, the screen is the controller
together.s1.text4: In Play, open the Play Together tab, press Start and invite, then share the QR code or the link. The same link works for friends on your Wi-Fi, on Tailscale or anywhere on the internet.
together.s2.text2: The game opens in their browser, in their language, with nothing to install. They type a name, and you press Allow when it pops up over the picture.
together.s2.title: Your friend scans or opens it
together.s3.text: On the TV they press PS and pick Quick Play. Each friend is a separate player with your picture and sound, up to three friends at once.
together.s3.title: They play as Player 2 to 4
together.safe.text: Nobody plays until you allow them, and you can remove anyone. One switch turns off friends' PS and Create buttons, so a stray press can't pull everyone out of the game.
together.safe.title: You stay in charge
together.tab.t1b: One invite for everyone: for each friend the app picks your home network, Tailscale or the internet
together.tab.t2: Guests play as the PS5 profile you pick in Settings › Play Together, or the TV asks them
together.tab.t3: Already playing? The people button on the Play bar opens the same invite
together.tab.text: Play has three tabs: Play my PS5, Play Together and Join a friend. On Play Together, one press of Start and invite wakes the PS5, starts the stream and shows the invite.
together.tab.title: Its own tab in Play
together.title: Play Together: your friends, on your PS5
tour.everywhere.text: Native apps for macOS, Windows, Linux, Android and iPhone, and a Docker image that serves the same app as a web page from a NAS or server. Several consoles? Add them all and switch with a tap.
tour.everywhere.title: On every device you have
tour.games.text: One grid for the games on your drives, your network shares and every console, with their updates and add-ons. Each game's page shows where it is and what you can do with it: Play, Launch on PS5, install, move or update.
tour.games.title: All your games, in one place
tour.lead: Everything between your devices and your PS5, built on its own fast transfer protocol.
tour.saves.text2: Back your saves up on a schedule or with one press, restore them, and copy one to another user on the same PS5 or to a friend. Emulator saves (PS1, PS2, Switch) too. Browse the console's drives like a folder on your computer: copy, move and open files both ways.
tour.saves.title: Saves and files
tour.title: Fill it, sort it, keep it
tour.upload.t1: Install from your computer, a link or a network share
tour.upload.t2b: A queue that carries on while you do other things: pause an upload, or send something else first
tour.upload.t3: Updates and add-ons install from each game's page
tour.upload.t4: Archives are unpacked, or sent as they are when that's what's in them (payloads, a jailbreak update)
tour.upload.text: Drop a package, a game folder, an image or an archive: the app works out what it is and does the right thing. Transfers are resumable and run at the full speed of your network, with thousands of small files packed together so they never crawl.
tour.upload.title: Upload & Install
tour.workshop.t1: Pause a conversion and carry on later; add more games to its queue while one is made
tour.workshop.t2: Use less of this computer: half the processor, at low priority, so it stays quick
tour.workshop.text: Turn a game folder into a package or a disk image, look inside one, and make images smaller with compression. Everything runs on your computer and goes to the console when it's ready.
tour.workshop.title: Workshop
ts.console.t1b: Only the devices you tick can reach it, and only Remote Play and PS5Upload answer
ts.console.t2b: A device that was turned away shows up, with Allow and Ignore
ts.console.t3b: Pause it without signing out: the PS5 sleeps and wakes safely either way
ts.console.text2: On the PS5's card in Connection, press Set up next to Tailscale and sign in, on this device or with the QR code on your phone. The PS5 gets its own Tailscale address, named after it with -ps5u.
ts.console.title: Put the PS5 on your tailnet
ts.device.chip: The status bar says how it's reaching the PS5:
ts.device.text2: On your computer, phone or tablet, open Settings › Tailscale and sign in to the same account, or let PS5Upload use the Tailscale app you already have. Your home network always comes first: only when the PS5 doesn't answer there does the app go through Tailscale, and it tells you when it switches.
ts.device.title: Then each of your devices
ts.friends.text: A friend doesn't need a Tailscale account. Send them an internet invite from Play Together and they join from their browser as Player 2 to 4.
ts.friends.title: Friends: an internet invite
ts.headscale.text: Run Headscale? Open Advanced before you sign in and enter your control server. You can name the device there too.
ts.headscale.title: Your own server works too
ts.lead: Play your PS5 from anywhere through your own Tailscale account. There's no Tailscale app to install on any device: the app and the PS5 join your tailnet by themselves.
ts.mine.text: Your phone, laptop or tablet signs in to your tailnet and reaches the PS5 as if you were home: play it, and use the rest of PS5Upload too.
ts.mine.title: Your own devices: Tailscale
ts.title: Tailscale: your PS5, from anywhere
